_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Guinea covering Fouta Djallon, Samori Ture, French Guinea, Sékou Touré's 'Non', and military eras.

910.name: Prehistoric Guinea
910.description: Stone Age settlement of Guinea's diverse ecological zones; early agriculture and iron-working.

sub_clusters.name: Neolithic Settlement
sub_clusters.description: Early farming communities in the Fouta Djallon highlands and coastal lowlands.

sub_clusters.name: Early Iron-Working
sub_clusters.description: Iron-smelting in the Guinea highlands; early metallurgical traditions.

920.name: Fouta Djallon Imamate
920.description: Fulbe jihad; theocratic Imamate; alternating alfaya-soriya rule; major West African Islamic state.

sub_clusters.name: Fulbe Jihad and Imamate Foundation
sub_clusters.description: Ibrahima Sori and Karamoko Alfa lead jihad against Jalonke; theocratic Imamate established.

sub_clusters.name: Imamate Governance and Trade
sub_clusters.description: Alternating alfaya-soriya almamy system; cattle economy; slave raiding; Islamic scholarship.

920.name: Mande and Coastal Peoples
920.description: Susu, Baga, Nalu coastal peoples; Mande expansion from interior; salt and iron trade.

sub_clusters.name: Susu and Baga Coastal Peoples
sub_clusters.description: Susu displace Baga toward coast; rice cultivation; salt production; engagement with Atlantic trade.

sub_clusters.name: Mali Empire Influence
sub_clusters.description: Upper Guinea as Mali Empire periphery; Mandinka governance and trade networks.

930.name: Samori Ture's Wassoulou Empire
930.description: Samori Ture builds the Wassoulou Empire; military innovation; epic resistance to French conquest.

sub_clusters.name: Empire Building
sub_clusters.description: Samori unifies Wassoulou; professional army with European firearms; Islamic state-building.

sub_clusters.name: Samori vs French Conquest
sub_clusters.description: Sustained resistance; scorched-earth retreats; captured 1898; exiled to Gabon.

940.name: French Guinea Colony
940.description: French colonial rule; forced labour; banana economy; rise of PDG and Sékou Touré.

sub_clusters.name: French Conquest and Pacification
sub_clusters.description: French impose control; Fouta Djallon conquered 1896; resistance in Forest Guinea.

sub_clusters.name: Colonial Economy
sub_clusters.description: Banana plantations; forced labour; mining concessions; minimal infrastructure investment.

sub_clusters.name: Rise of PDG and Sékou Touré
sub_clusters.description: Parti Démocratique de Guinée (PDG); Sékou Touré trade unionist; 1953 general strike.

950.name: Sékou Touré Era
950.description: Historic 'Non' to de Gaulle; radical independence; single-party state; Camp Boiro; isolation.

sub_clusters.name: Guinea Says 'Non' to de Gaulle
sub_clusters.description: Guinea alone votes 'Non' in de Gaulle's referendum; immediate independence 2 October 1958; French retaliation.

sub_clusters.name: Sékou Touré's Dictatorship
sub_clusters.description: One-party PDG state; Camp Boiro prison; 'permanent revolution'; Soviet alignment; economic collapse.

sub_clusters.name: Operation Green Sea (Portuguese Invasion)
sub_clusters.description: Portuguese forces invade Conakry from Guinea-Bissau; attack PAIGC bases; UN condemnation.

960.name: Lansana Conté Military Era
960.description: Conté seizes power after Touré's death; liberalisation then stagnation; bauxite wealth squandered.

sub_clusters.name: Conté Military Rule and Transition
sub_clusters.description: Conté bloodless coup 1984; partial liberalisation; multiparty elections 1993; authoritarian drift.

sub_clusters.name: Bauxite Economy
sub_clusters.description: Guinea holds world's largest bauxite reserves; mining wealth; resource curse dynamics.

960.name: Post-Conté Instability and Coups
960.description: Moussa Dadis Camara; stadium massacre; Alpha Condé democratic era; 2021 military coup.

sub_clusters.name: Camara Junta and Stadium Massacre
sub_clusters.description: Dadis Camara junta; 28 September 2009 stadium massacre of opposition; international outcry.

sub_clusters.name: Alpha Condé Presidency
sub_clusters.description: First democratic transfer; new constitution controversy 2020; third-term grab.

sub_clusters.name: 2021 Military Coup
sub_clusters.description: Colonel Mamady Doumbouya overthrows Condé September 2021; CNRD junta; suspended constitution.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
